description: SSEN Transmission Pole Grid is a dataset listed in SSEN Transmission Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SSEN Transmission is a trading name of Scottish Hydro Electric Transmission plc, company number SC213461. Shapefile containing SSEN Transmission Grid Poles. Please see 'Export' tab for style sheets. To view or download this data, please register or login. Coverage: north of Scotland (SSEN Transmission network area). The portal files it under Infrastructure. Its keywords are 132kV, Pole, Shapefile, Grid, Network Infrastructure. The portal shows 3,714 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-ssentransmission-portal.
